modalities.evidence: These data were recorded from 37 subjects
Subjects completed a novel, visual contextual trajectory paradigm (CTP)

output.population: Human; Healthy / Control; ages 17–30; 37 subjects with normal or corrected vision and no history of neurological disorder
output.summary: EEG from healthy young adults completing a visual contextual trajectory paradigm in which a stimulus violated an established trajectory in brightness, size, or orientation, with control trials where no attribute was violated.
